description: The test file uses two distinct naming conventions without explanation: bare names like 'email_set_create_and_get' (unit-style) and prefixed names like 'conformance_email_get_by_id' (conformance-suite-style). Some tests for the same handler appear in both groups (e.g. email_set_create_and_get and conformance_email_set_create_basic test overlapping behaviour). A contributor adding a new test does not know which convention to follow or which group to add to. A brief section header comment explaining the distinction between the two groups would resolve this.
title: integration.rs: two naming conventions make test suite hard to navigate
